associations.rationale: This gives only the cardinality of the index type, not the asserted family properties.

It asserts the existence of some simple, pairwise-nonisomorphic family with the stated cardinality, but the displayed type does not identify that family as the one-dimensional and principal-series representations.
This supplies only the pairwise-nonisomorphism component of the family claim.
This supplies only the simplicity component of the family claim.
